name: Scheduled task
why: A recurring job, from its README row to a run that ends clean
ideal: Each recurring job is a named task that starts on time, ends without error and keeps its up-front connector load small.

sources.title: Claude Code Docs: Automate work with scheduled tasks

steps.name: Define
steps.rule: Each recurring job is a named scheduled task with its run time.

steps.name: Fire
steps.rule: A run starts within ten minutes of its time.

steps.name: Connect
steps.rule: A task keeps its up-front connector load small, with every connector on.

steps.name: Run
steps.rule: The latest run of every task ends without an error.
